findings.summary: Three `or`-chain fallbacks read keys out of `_call_params_config` that that dict can never contain, so they always evaluate to None and contribute nothing: `max_react_iterations` at lines 745 and 1629, and `max_tool_result_length` at line 1784. `_call_params_config` is the module-level glob set in `llm.jac:51` from `_byllm_config.get_call_params_config()`, whose implementation at `impl/config_loader.impl.jac:60-75` builds a fresh dict containing at most three keys — `max_output_retries` always, `temperature` only if present in jac.toml, `max_tokens` only if > 0 — and nothing else; it is a whitelist, not a passthrough, so a user putting `max_react_iterations` under `[byllm.call_params]` would have it dropped. I grepped the whole repo for both names: every real usage is a per-call or per-model parameter (`tests/fixtures/react_max_iterations.jac:19`, `react_max_iterations_finish_tool.jac:28`, `jac/jaclang/cli/ai_agent.jac:286,288`), which the first two links of each chain (`mt_run.call_params` / `self.call_params`) already cover, and the docs table at `docs/reference/plugins/byllm.md:823,827` lists them as `by llm(...)` options, not jac.toml keys. Each chain already ends in a literal default (`or 0`, `or 500`), so deleting the third link is behaviour-preserving.

Two `_model_config` lookups in `Model.postinit` can never hit: `_model_config.get("http_client", False)` at line 4 and `_model_config.get("native_tools")` at line 35. `_model_config` is the glob set in `llm.jac:50` from `_byllm_config.get_model_config()`, and that implementation (`impl/config_loader.impl.jac:48-58`) returns a freshly built dict with exactly five keys — `default_model`, `api_key`, `base_url`, `proxy`, `verbose` — so both lookups always return the hard-coded default (`False` and `None` respectively). I grepped the repo for `native_tools|http_client`: every genuine setter goes through the per-`Model` `config={...}` dict — `tests/test_byllm.jac:1757` (`config={"native_tools": True}`), `tests/fixtures/system_prompt_override/direct_http_model_call.jac:14` and `byllm/README.md:117` (`"http_client": True`) — which the outer `self.config.get(...)` already handles. Neither key appears in `get_default_config` or in the `[byllm.model]` schema in `plugin_config.jac`, confirming they were never jac.toml keys. The lines reduce to `self.config.get("http_client", False)` and `self.config.get("native_tools")` with identical behaviour.
